title: 金假金丝雀的博弈第10章
content_zh:
第10章 他的底牌

    周日早上七点，顾西辞的电话来了。

    “今天不休息。八点到我办公室。”

    “周日也要加班？”

    “不是加班。是给你看一样东西。”

    “什么东西？”

    “来了就知道了。”

    电话挂了。我从被窝里爬起来，盯着天花板上的水渍看了几秒，然后下床洗漱。这个人每次说“来了就知道了”的时候，通常意味着他准备了什么我不想面对的东西。

    八点整我推开他办公室的门。顾西辞坐在办公桌后面，面前摊着一堆文件，衬衫袖子照例卷到手肘，但今天没喝咖啡。桌上放着一杯白开水，还冒着热气。

    “坐。”

    我坐在他对面的椅子上。他把一份文件推到我面前，黑色封面，没有标题，厚度大概有二十页。

    “这是什么？”

    “许向平的完整档案。从他进万盛的第一天到现在，所有的投资决策、人事变动、关联交易，还有他个人账户的异常资金流动。我让人整理了两个月，昨晚才全部核实完。”

    我翻开第一页。密密麻麻的数据、日期、金额，每一项都标注了来源。有些是从公开财报里扒出来的，有些是从内部渠道核实的，还有些标注着“匿名信源提供，已交叉验证”。

    “你给我看这个干什么？”

    “因为下一阶段你会直接跟许向平打交道。你需要知道他所有的弱点。”他从文件堆里抽出一张纸，上面是他手写的几个名字，字迹很潦草但很有力，“许向平有三个致命弱点。第一个，他贪。去年他在万盛的并购案里吃了回扣，金额不大，但证据在我手里。第二个，他怕林子明。林子明是他老丈人，他能在万盛坐到今天全靠林家。一旦林子明对他失去信任，他在万盛一天都待不下去。第三个——你看最后一页。”

    我翻到最后一页。上面是一张银行转账记录截图，收款方是一个私人账户，开户人名字叫顾明珠。

    “许向平给顾明珠转过钱？”

    “三笔。第一笔是身份揭穿之前一周，第二笔是认亲宴当天早上，第三笔是上周末。”顾西辞靠在椅背上，手指在桌面敲了两下，“三笔加起来不小。你觉得是为什么？”

    我盯着那个数字看了很久。顾明珠和许向平，这两个人我从来没有把他们放在一起想过。一个是刚从外面找回来的真千金，一个是万盛的副总裁。他们之间能有什么交易？

    “情报。”我把文件合上，“许向平需要一个在顾家内部的信息源。顾明珠需要钱。各取所需。”

    “不只。”顾西辞站起来走到窗边，“你还记不记得林薇在林氏晚宴上录我们跳舞的视频？那条视频最后没有发出去，因为她的经纪公司拦住了。但经纪人后来跟我说了一件事——林薇在录视频之前接了一个电话。那个电话是顾明珠打的。”

    “顾明珠指使林薇录视频？”

    “不。顾明珠只是告诉林薇我们会在晚宴上跳舞，时间、地点、站位，都说了。林薇自己决定要录。但顾明珠提供信息给林薇，这个行为本身就在往外漏顾家的内部安排。林薇是许向平那边的，信息到了林薇手里，等于到了许向平手里。”

    走廊里有脚步声经过，又渐渐远了。办公室里的暖气出风口发出轻微的嗡嗡声，窗外是周日空旷的街道。我看着顾西辞的背影，他站在落地窗前，双手插在西装裤口袋里，肩膀的线条很直很硬，像一把还没出鞘的刀。
content_en:
Chapter 10 His trump card

    At seven o'clock on Sunday morning, Gu Xici's call came.

    "No day off today. Come to my office at eight o'clock."

    "Do you have to work overtime on Sundays?"

    "It's not about working overtime. It's about showing you something."

    "What?"

    "You'll know when you get here."

    The phone was hung up. I got up from the bed, stared at the water stains on the ceiling for a few seconds, and then got out of bed to wash up. Every time this person says "you'll find out when you get there", it usually means that he has prepared something that I don't want to face.

    At eight o'clock sharp I opened the door to his office. Gu Xici sat behind his desk with a pile of documents spread out in front of him. His shirt sleeves were rolled up to his elbows as usual, but he didn't drink coffee today. There is a glass of boiled water on the table, still steaming.

    "Sit."

    I sat in the chair opposite him. He pushed a document in front of me. It had a black cover, no title, and was about twenty pages thick.

    "What is this?"

    "Xu Xiangping's complete file. From the first day he joined Wansheng until now, all investment decisions, personnel changes, related transactions, and abnormal fund flows in his personal account. I had people sort it out for two months, and only verified it all last night."

    I turned to the first page. Densely packed data, dates, amounts, each item is marked with its source. Some were extracted from public financial reports, some were verified from internal channels, and some were marked "provided by anonymous sources and cross-verified."

    "Why are you showing me this?"

    "Because you will deal directly with Xu Xiangping in the next stage. You need to know all his weaknesses." He pulled out a piece of paper from the pile of documents. On it were several names written in his handwriting. The handwriting was very sloppy but very powerful. "Xu Xiangping has three fatal weaknesses. The first one is that he is greedy. Last year he was in Wansheng's The kickback was not large, but the evidence is in my hands. Secondly, he is afraid of Lin Ziming. Lin Ziming is his father-in-law, and his success in Wansheng depends on the Lin family. Once Lin Ziming loses trust in him, he will not be able to stay in Wansheng for a day. "

    I turned to the last page. Above is a screenshot of a bank transfer record. The payee is a private account, and the account holder's name is Gu Mingzhu.

    "Xu Xiangping transferred money to Gu Mingzhu?"

    "Three strokes. The first stroke was a week before the identity was revealed, the second stroke was on the morning of the recognition banquet, and the third stroke was last weekend." Gu Xici leaned back in his chair and tapped his fingers on the table twice. "The three strokes add up to a lot. Why do you think it is?"

    I stared at that number for a long time. Gu Mingzhu and Xu Xiangping, I have never thought of these two people together. One is the real daughter who has just been found from outside, and the other is the vice president of Wansheng. What kind of deal can there be between them?

    "Intelligence." I closed the document, "Xu Xiangping needs an information source within the Gu family. Gu Mingzhu needs money. Everyone gets what they need."

    "Not only." Gu Xici stood up and walked to the window, "Do you still remember that Lin Wei recorded a video of us dancing at Lin's dinner? That video was not sent out in the end because her agency blocked it. But her agent later told me something - Lin Wei answered a phone call before recording the video. The call was made by Gu Mingzhu."

    "Gu Mingzhu instructed Lin Wei to record the video?"

    "No. Gu Mingzhu just told Lin Wei that we would dance at the dinner. The time, place, and standing positions were all mentioned. Lin Wei decided to record it on her own. But Gu Mingzhu provided information to Lin Wei, which in itself leaked the Gu family's internal arrangements. Lin Wei is from Xu Xiangping's side. When the information reaches Lin Wei's hands, it is equivalent to being in Xu Xiangping's hands."

    Footsteps passed by in the corridor, and then became distant again. There was a slight hum coming from the heating vents in the office, and the windows looked out onto the empty Sunday streets. I looked at Gu Xici's back. He was standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, with his hands in the pockets of his suit trousers. The lines of his shoulders were straight and hard, like a knife that had not been sheathed.
